tasks.short: Develop and implement fund investment policies

steps.what: Open the fund investment policy points
Draft strategies from the stored policy points

loop.purpose: Draft a policy line only from a point the manager has stored.
loop.input: Fund id and the manager's stored points.
loop.output: Draft policy lines, or a stop.
loop.check: Every line cites a stored point id.
loop.stop: Stop when a line has no stored point.
loop.why_not_simpler: A policy that adds a strategy the manager did not write cannot be signed.

steps.what: Develop and implement the investment policy
File the investment policy the manager signed

tasks.design: Policy points the manager wrote are opened in {DOCS}. A draft strategy cites only those points. The manager develops the policy, implements it with the team in a meeting, and signs it. The draft does not set the strategy.
tasks.previous_blocker: The policy was rewritten from an old document, and it was unclear which line was still meant.
tasks.enabler_now: The points are stored, so a draft can arrange them without adding a new strategy.
tasks.still_hard: What the policy should say, and how it is implemented, stay with the manager.

ambition.what: Stored points become a draft the day they are written, and the manager still signs the policy.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees their own points beside the draft.

evidence.claim: A policy draft cites points the manager stored, and the manager signs and implements it. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the fund's investment policy is being written and ends when the manager has signed it.
A point has fund id, point id, and text, written by the manager. A line with no point id is dropped.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the committee wants a format the stored points do not cover.
research_questions: Which drafts are waiting because a point was missing?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: policy the manager signed for that fund

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts policies whose points are already stored. A new strategy is written by the manager, and the signature stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate research that informs forecasting and valuation

steps.what: Open stored company and industry filings
Draft the research note from those filings

loop.purpose: Draft a research note that quotes only stored filing lines.
loop.input: Company id and the stored filing lines.
loop.output: A note citing those lines, or a stop.
loop.check: Every quoted line equals a stored filing line.
loop.stop: Stop when the note would need a line that is not stored.
loop.why_not_simpler: A valuation note that invents a figure cannot be used.

steps.what: Evaluate the research for forecasting and valuation

tasks.design: Company and industry filings that are already stored are opened from {DOCS}. A note may quote only those lines. The manager performs the evaluation and decides what it means for forecasting and valuation. A figure that is not in the filing is not in the note.
tasks.previous_blocker: The analysis was rewritten from filings each time, and a figure was easy to mistype.
tasks.enabler_now: The filing lines are stored, so a note can quote them instead of retyping them.
tasks.still_hard: What the filing means for a decision stays with the manager.

ambition.what: A stored filing can be quoted the day it is filed, and the manager still makes the valuation.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the filing line beside the note.

evidence.claim: A research note quotes stored filings, and the manager evaluates them. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when research is needed for a valuation and ends when the manager has written the evaluation.
A filing line has company id, line id, and amount, produced by the filed accounts. A missing line stops the draft.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How complete the stored filings are for the companies this fund holds.
research_questions: Which notes stopped because a line was not stored?

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts notes whose lines are already stored. The evaluation and the valuation stay with the manager.

tasks.short: Present investment risks, fees, and performance statistics

steps.what: Open investment risks, fees, and statistics
Fill the presentation from the stored statistics
Present the investment information and check it
Release the performance presentation the manager accepted

tasks.design: Risks, fees, and performance statistics are opened from {BI} and {DOCS}. A presentation is filled only with those stored facts. The manager presents and checks it before {EMAIL} releases it. A blank fact stays blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same statistics were copied into a slide from a side sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: The facts are stored against the fund, so the slides can be filled without copying.
tasks.still_hard: What to say about a risk, beyond the stored fact, stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager accepts the presentation before a client sees it.

ambition.what: A fund with stored statistics gets a draft presentation the day they update, and the manager still accepts it.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees each fact beside the slide.

evidence.claim: A presentation is a locked set of stored facts, and the manager accepts it before release. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when investment information is to be presented and ends when the manager has accepted the presentation.
A fact has fund id, kind, and value, produced by the books or the fee schedule. A missing value is left blank.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.

tasks.short: Develop and monitor security valuation policies

steps.what: Open the security valuation method register
Draft valuation policy lines from stored methods

loop.purpose: Draft a valuation policy line only from a stored method id.
loop.input: Security id and the stored valuation method.
loop.output: A draft line, or a stop.
loop.check: The method in the draft equals the stored method id.
loop.stop: Stop when the security has no stored method.
loop.why_not_simpler: A valuation policy that invents a method cannot be signed.

steps.what: Implement the valuation policy and sign it
Monitor prices against the security valuation policy

tasks.design: Each security's valuation method is opened from {DOCS}. A draft line copies that method and stops if it is missing. The manager implements and signs the policy. Later, prices are monitored on {BI} only by whether they used the signed method. A mismatch is an exception, not a new price.
tasks.previous_blocker: The valuation method lived in a memo, and a price could be used without anyone checking the memo.
tasks.enabler_now: The method is stored per security, so a draft can cite it and a later price can be compared with it.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the method, and what to do about an exception, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager signs the policy and reads the exceptions.

ambition.what: A security with a stored method is on the policy the day it is added, and the manager still signs.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the method beside the price.

reach.learn: Which security used a different method.

evidence.claim: A valuation policy cites a stored method, and the manager signs it and reads later exceptions. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a valuation policy is written or a price arrives and ends when the manager has signed the policy and seen the exceptions.
A method row has security id and method id, written by the manager. A security with no method is not given one by the draft.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often a price feed names the method it used.
research_questions: Which securities have a price with no method id?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts securities whose method is already stored. A missing method is set by the manager, and the signature stays.
